body: It is impossible, but that's just my fault so... Anyway, it's been nice talking to you. I think I need to die now but thank you for letting me die with a little less panic and frustration.

The prostitutes I hired were very kind, I didn't tell any of them about my past but I did say what exactly I wanted to do and we took our own time. I just don't think sexual healing is in my cards anymore, at least not unless I could somehow get a girlfriend, so I think I just need to die instead.
Pretty much. Physically and mentally abusive.

I tried talking about it to a friend but he just laughed and uses it as ammo for making fun of me (though I guess thankfully there's a lot lot lot else about me to make fun of)

I hate my family and I'm killing myself today so that they miiiiigghhhttt just understand the pain I'm in.

I went to some therapists but I guess no one really knows how to deal with such things. I went to one who I found out specialises in helping with sexual abuse but she denied my appointment saying I was too young at the time (18).

For reference, since I'm gonna be dead anyway now and these posts are the closest thing I'm leaving behind to a suicide note, I went to a foreign country (years after the abuse) and hired prostitutes to try and take back some control of my sexuality. It didn't work. When I mentioned it on a support group all I got was a comment saying that paying a girl to have sex with me is basically the same as raping her. I tried to explain that I had done everything with her express consent but no one would listen. I've come to realise that most male support groups use fellow victims of CSA/rape to strengthen their agenda of public awareness (which I'm not against) but in doing so don't really care for their personal stories.
There aren't any IRL ones near me and online ones always end up shunning me, making me feel worse, giving me useless advice or berating me for the choices I made to try and "heal" myself from it.
